_comment: Gate-shaped tools deliberately NOT run by tools/run-tests.sh. Enforced by tools/gate-census.mjs: a gate that is neither reachable from the suite nor listed here fails the census, and an entry naming a file that no longer exists fails it too. A reason must say why the tool CANNOT be green in the suite — 'nobody got round to it' is not one; wire it instead.

_schema.reason: why this cannot be a suite leg
_schema.owner: the task that would change that, if any

tools/386/run-386box.sh.reason: BLOCKED: needs a FreeDOS disk image and a DOS DOOM.EXE, neither in the repo (docs/386/BRING-UP.md). It also measures id's vanilla DOS binary as a 386 baseline, not this codebase, so it could never gate a change here.

tools/baremetal/run-check.sh.reason: BLOCKED: OS-less ARM under QEMU boots, but per-tic hash streaming over the emulated UART is unresolved (tools/baremetal/README.md, 13.4b residual). Without the hashes there is nothing to assert.

tools/coverage/run-coverage.sh.reason: Produces a coverage REPORT, not a verdict: there is no committed floor to regress against, so wiring it would add runtime and assert nothing. Give it a floor and it becomes a leg.
